screen: Talent Management → Onboarding & Employee Lifecycle Center (unit: tm-onboarding). Single mount point: /module/talent-management/onboarding, menuId 48 (hooks/content-map-m3.ts:16). All five assigned files exist and were read in full.
screenLevelGaps: CUSTOMER SUSPICION CONFIRMED (1/2) - a new hire's role does NOT trigger competency framework mapping. `grep -rni 'skill|competenc|jobrole|job_role' app/Http/Controllers/Api/Onboarding/` returns exactly ONE hit, and it is a comment ('Mirrors ResolvesPerformanceContext / ResolvesCompetencyContext', ResolvesOnboardingContext.php:13). No onboarding endpoint reads or writes s_skill_matrix, s_jobrole_skills, s_user_jobrole, s_user_skill_jobrole or user_rating_details. There is no code path, and there is no mechanism that could carry one: app/Events, app/Listeners and app/Observers do not exist.

THE STRUCTURAL BLOCKER FOR COMPETENCY MAPPING IS THE DATA MODEL, NOT JUST MISSING CODE. `position` on a journey is a FREE-TEXT string (onboarding-sheets.tsx:399 Input; OnboardingJourneyController.php:139 'position' => 'nullable|string|max:191'). `grep -rn 'jobrole|job_role' database/migrations/*onboarding*` returns nothing - talent_onboarding_journeys has NO jobrole_id column. The competency framework is keyed on jobrole_id (s_jobrole_skills, s_user_jobrole, s_user_skill_jobrole). A typed job title cannot be joined to a job-role-keyed framework, so mapping is not merely unimplemented - it is unimplementable without a schema change plus a jobrole picker on the Journey sheet sourced from HRIT's job-role master.

CUSTOMER SUSPICION CONFIRMED (2/2) - no onboarding learning path is created in LMS. Zero references to lms_*, sub_std_map, lms_assignments, lms_course_enroll or lms_certificates in the entire onboarding module. The plumbing to do it already exists and is used by a sibling module: LearningAssignmentController.php:31/206 writes lms_assignments rows tagged source='competency', and routes/api.php:625 exposes POST /lmsAssignment. Onboarding should write the equivalent source='onboarding' induction curriculum rows on journey creation. It writes none.

THE 'Learning & Training' WORKSTREAM CARD IS A FACADE. It looks like an LMS integration ('Onboarding Integrations & Tasks', onboarding-center.tsx:982) but OnboardingTaskController::workstreams (lines 398-457) is a GROUP BY category over talent_onboarding_tasks. Its 'X of Y tasks complete' caption counts hand-typed to-do rows whose only relationship to LMS is that someone chose the word 'Learning' from a dropdown. A hire can show 'Learning & Training: Completed' with zero course enrollments and zero completions in lms_course_enroll.

journey.employee_id IS NEVER SET BY ANY UI PATH, WHICH SILENTLY KILLS FOUR FEATURES. JourneySheet (onboarding-sheets.tsx:275-287 EMPTY_JOURNEY, 345-357 submit payload) has no employee_id field. storeFromOffer (OnboardingJourneyController.php:213-224) does not set it either. Nothing in the module creates a tbluser row. Consequences, all verified: (a) 'View Employee Profile' is gated on `journey.employee_id &&` (onboarding-sidebar.tsx:137) so it never renders; (b) mirrorToEmployee() early-returns on `if (!$journey->employee_id)` (OnboardingProbationController.php:304-306), so the advertised tbluser probation sync never runs; (c) the timeline's tbluser employment-date lookup (OnboardingJourneyController.php:613-623) never executes; (d) there is no tbluser id to write an LMS assignment or a competency profile against even if that code were added.

ONBOARDING TASKS ARE INVISIBLE TO THE TASK MANAGEMENT MODULE. Onboarding writes talent_onboarding_tasks; Task Management reads/writes the `task` table (AJAXController / Api/TaskController.php uses DB::table('task') at lines 83, 87, 91, 178, 277, 327, 380). Two disjoint stores. Per the ownership model Task Mgmt = EXECUTE work, so an IT-provisioning or induction task assigned to the IT lead should land in that person's task inbox. It does not appear there at all - the owner only ever sees it if they open this HR screen.

REMINDERS DO NOT SEND ANYTHING. 'Send reminders for open tasks' (onboarding-center.tsx:494), the bulk 'Send reminder' (line 665) and the row 'Send Reminder' (line 845) all POST /onboarding/tasks/bulk action=remind, which only appends an activity-log row - the controller says so explicitly: 'Reminders are recorded on the feed; delivery is the notification layer's job, which this module does not own' (OnboardingTaskController.php:332-346). The UI reports 'N task(s) reminded' with no delivery attempted.

JOURNEY-STAGE FILTER BUG - the dropdown offers values that can never match and omits the two that can. GET /onboarding/filters builds `stages` from DEFAULT_STAGES stage_keys (OnboardingOverviewController.php:334-337): offer_accepted, preboarding, first_day, orientation, team_integration, probation, confirmation. But journey.stage is validated as preboarding|first_day|orientation|team_integration|probation|confirmed|exited (OnboardingJourneyController.php:141) and filtered with a plain `where('stage', $stage)` (line 796). So selecting 'Offer Accepted' or 'Confirmation' in JourneyListSheet (onboarding-sheets.tsx:628-632) always returns zero rows, and there is NO way to list confirmed or exited hires.

KPI 'Active Onboarding' DRILL-DOWN DOES NOT MATCH ITS OWN COUNT. The tile counts stage IN (first_day, orientation, team_integration, probation) AND status IN (not-started, in-progress, on-hold) (OnboardingOverviewController.php:48-51), but its 'View all' applies only {status:'in-progress'} (line 116, consumed at onboarding-center.tsx:317). A preboarding hire with status in-progress is listed but not counted; a first_day hire with status not-started is counted but not listed.

KPI 'Onboarding Completion' DRILL-DOWN IS DOUBLY WRONG. The tile aggregates tasks across ALL open journeys (OnboardingOverviewController.php:62-78). Its 'View pending tasks' sets moreFilters.status='pending' and switches to the Preboarding tab (onboarding-center.tsx:310-315), but the task table is permanently scoped to one journey (`journey_id: journeyKey`, line 211), so it shows one hire's tasks. It also filters status='pending' only, excluding the in_progress / sent / blocked tasks that the tile also counts as incomplete.

'Export tasks (CSV)' AND 'Send reminders for open tasks' SILENTLY OPERATE ON ONE PAGE ONLY. Both read the `tasks` array (onboarding-center.tsx:395 and 418), which holds only the current page (per_page default 25, line 206). With 90 tasks the export writes 25 rows and reports 'Exported 25 task(s).' (line 414) with no indication that 65 were omitted. The CSV filename even implies otherwise: `onboarding-tasks-${journey?.journey_code ?? 'all'}.csv` (line 410).

NO NEW-HIRE-FACING AND NO MANAGER-FACING ONBOARDING VIEW EXIST. The spec asks for an Employee (as new hire) 'onboarding checklist & task tracker (Day 1-30/60/90 plan)', 'Buddy/mentor info access' and 'Pre-boarding document submission status' (TalentManagementFeatures.txt:168-171), and a Manager 'Onboarding task tracker for own team' (lines 78-80). There is exactly one mount of OnboardingCenter (content-map-m3.ts:16) and it is the HR admin console - no self-service or team-scoped variant exists anywhere in the frontend.

A JOURNEY'S status AND stage CANNOT BE EDITED FROM THE UI. The API accepts both on PUT /onboarding/journeys/{id} (OnboardingJourneyController.php:258-259) but JourneySheet never sends them (onboarding-sheets.tsx:345-357). There is therefore no way to put a journey On Hold or Cancel it; status only changes as a side effect of syncJourneyStage() or a probation decision. The v2 route table also has no journeys/{id}/complete equivalent to the v1 route at routes/api.php:1161.

STAGE STATUSES 'skipped' AND 'in_progress' ARE UNREACHABLE. PUT /onboarding/stages/{id} validates status in pending|in_progress|completed|skipped (OnboardingJourneyController.php:411) and onboarding-shared.tsx:123-134 renders badge variants for all four, but StageDialog has no status control and its payload is {title, start_date, end_date, notes} only (onboarding-sheets.tsx:1542-1547). The only status control is the binary checkbox in JourneyTab (onboarding-tabs.tsx:151-156).

THE TASK OWNER DROPDOWN COLLAPSES TO EXISTING OWNERS ONLY. `withAll(options?.owners?.length ? options.owners : options?.employees ?? [], 'Unassigned')` (onboarding-sheets.tsx:154-157). options.owners is built from DISTINCT owner_id already present on tasks plus free-text owner_labels (OnboardingOverviewController.php:214-237). As soon as one task has any owner, the 500-employee list is dropped and a task can no longer be assigned to anyone who has not already owned one.

BULK ACTIONS 'reopen' AND 'reassign' EXIST IN THE API AND HAVE NO UI. POST /onboarding/tasks/bulk validates action in complete|reopen|delete|reassign|remind (OnboardingTaskController.php:299) and the frontend type BulkTaskAction lists all five (services/talent/onboarding.ts:377), but the selection bar renders only Mark complete / Send reminder / Delete (onboarding-center.tsx:654-699). Bulk reassignment of a departing coordinator's tasks is impossible from the screen.

THE OFFBOARDING MODULE NEVER CLOSES THE LIFECYCLE. journey.stage accepts 'exited' and journeyStageVariant renders it (onboarding-shared.tsx:86), but `grep -rn 'onboarding' app/Http/Controllers/Api/Offboarding/*.php` returns nothing and OnboardingJourney is referenced only inside Api/Onboarding, Api/Talent and TalentDashboardController. An employee can be fully offboarded while their onboarding journey still reads Confirmed.

DUPLICATE LIVE ROUTE SURFACE. A v1 onboarding API is still registered at /talent/onboarding/journeys|tasks|documents (routes/api.php:1157-1173) backed by app/Http/Controllers/Api/Talent/Onboarding*Controller.php over the SAME tables, with different rules (v1 requires employee_id, OnboardingJourneyController.php:117). This screen uses only the v2 /onboarding/* family. Two writable APIs over one dataset with divergent validation is a data-integrity risk for a product being sold.

DEAD CODE / UNCONSUMED DATA IN THE SHIPPED BUNDLE: (a) onboardingService.uploadDocument (multipart journey-level create, services/talent/onboarding.ts:667) and its hook wrapper mutations.uploadDocument (use-onboarding.ts:523-536) are never called - DocumentsSheet uses createDocument + uploadDocumentFile instead; (b) useJourneyDetail fetches and stores documentSummary (use-onboarding.ts:196, 230, 250) and the center never destructures it, so the pending/sent/received/verified counts are computed server-side and thrown away; (c) InlineSpinner (onboarding-shared.tsx:196) and SidebarSkeleton (onboarding-sheets.tsx:1641) are exported and never used.

PROBATION TAB DOES NOT EXPOSE TWO FILTERS ITS API SUPPORTS. GET /onboarding/probation accepts department_id and overdue_only (OnboardingProbationController.php:50, 64-66) and ProbationFilters types both (services/talent/onboarding.ts:481-484), but ProbationTab renders only search, confirmation_status and due_in_days (onboarding-tabs.tsx:268-297). An HR head cannot slice the confirmation queue by department or jump straight to overdue confirmations.
